```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer

class DataCleaning:
    def __init__(self):
        self.actions_log = []
        self.num_vars = [
            "IDpol",
            "ClaimNb",
            "Exposure",
            "VehPower",
            "VehAge",
            "DrivAge",
            "BonusMalus",
            "Density"
        ]
        self.cat_vars = [
            "Area",
            "VehBrand",
            "VehGas",
            "Region"
        ]

    def clean(self, data: pd.DataFrame):
        # Clip outliers / right-censoring 
        self.actions_log.append("Clipping VehAge (<=20), DrivAge (<=90), BonusMalus (<=150), ClaimNb (<=5).")
        data['VehAge'] = data['VehAge'].clip(upper=20)
        data['DrivAge'] = data['DrivAge'].clip(upper=90)
        data['BonusMalus'] = data['BonusMalus'].clip(upper=150)
        data['ClaimNb'] = data['ClaimNb'].clip(upper=5)

        # Encode categorical variables
        self.actions_log.append("Encoded categorical variables.")
        encoder = OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore")
        encoded_data = encoder.fit_transform(data[self.cat_vars])
        encoded_data = pd.DataFrame(encoded_data.toarray(), columns=encoder.get_feature_names_out(self.cat_vars))

        # Remove original categorical columns
        data = data.drop(columns=self.cat_vars)

        # Concatenate encoded data with original data
        data = pd.concat([data, encoded_data], axis=1)

        # Impute missing values
        self.actions_log.append("Imputed missing values in DrivAge.")
        imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy='mean')
        data['DrivAge'] = imputer.fit_transform(data[['DrivAge']])

        # Select relevant features
        self.actions_log.append("Selected relevant features.")
        data = data.drop(columns=['IDpol', 'ClaimNb'])

        # Normalize numeric columns
        self.actions_log.append("Normalized numeric columns.")
        scaler = StandardScaler()
        numeric_data = data[self.num_vars]
        numeric_data = scaler.fit_transform(numeric_data)
        data[self.num_vars] = numeric_data

        return data
```
